|game_text=Deploy on C-3PO. Eyes In The Dark, The Professor, Mantellian Savrip and Hopping Mad are immune to Alter. Also, at the end of every turn, unless C-3PO is present with a Wookiee, you may examine the cards in your Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
|joke=In ''The Empire Strikes Back'', Chewbacca puts Threepio's head back on the wrong way round, and Threepio cries "I'm backwards, you stupid furball".
